title: UGC NET Result December 2025 Declared: Download Scorecard, Check Cut-Off, JRF & PhD Eligibility
text:
New Delhi, February 5, 2026
UGC NET December 2025 Result Officially Declared
The National Testing Agency (NTA) has officially declared the UGC NET December 2025 examination results. Candidates who appeared for the exam can now download their scorecards from the official website using their application number and date of birth.
The result determines eligibility for Junior Research Fellowship (JRF), Assistant Professor positions, and PhD admissions across Indian universities and colleges.
📌 Final Answer Key Released After Objection Review
Before declaring the results, NTA carefully reviewed objections raised by candidates against the provisional answer key. After evaluation, the final answer key was released, and the results have been prepared based on it.
Candidates are advised to check their marks, qualification status, and cut-off scores carefully and retain a copy of the scorecard for future reference.
📊 Subject-Wise and Category-Wise Cut-Off Marks Released
Along with the results, UGC NET cut-off marks have also been published. The cut-offs vary by subject and category, including:
General
OBC
SC
ST
EWS
✅ Minimum Qualifying Marks
General & General-EWS: Minimum 40% aggregate in both papers
SC, ST, OBC, PwD & Third Gender: Minimum 35% aggregate
Only candidates meeting the subject-wise and category-wise cut-off have been declared qualified.
👥 Over 7.35 Lakh Candidates Appeared
A total of 7,35,592 candidates appeared for the UGC NET December 2025 examination. The exam was conducted on multiple days, leading to variation in daily attendance. Overall, the attendance rate ranged between 71% and 75%, according to official data.
🧾 How to Check and Download UGC NET Result
Candidates can follow these steps to access their scorecard:
Visit the
official UGC NET websiteClick on the “Result / Scorecard” link on the homepage
Enter your Application Number and Date of Birth
Click on
Submit / LoginYour UGC NET scorecard will appear on the screen
Download and printthe scorecard for future use
